messages:
leah-peopleops: FYI team — short compliance note: our summer attestation window opens Mon Jun 7 and closes Jun 21 23:59 UTC. Everyone with a Redwood account must either attest or upload required evidence by the deadline. Form + Evidence Locker: https://redwood.example.com/summer-attest-2026 :calendar:

leah-peopleops: New for this cycle: were explicitly asking for CI/CD proof for services (pipeline run ID or a build log snippet) and key-rotation proof for any managed KMS keys (screenshot or rotation policy excerpt). See the form for templates.

omar-eng: Quick Q: for model serving squads, is an automated deploy history (Link to CI job) + short owner note ok for change-control?

sarah-security: Yes — a CI link + PR link + timestamped deploy log is fine for change control. For key rotation, a KMS policy + rotation timestamp or a screenshot of the rotation event works. If you can export a CSV of rotation events even better.

jin-privacy: Reminder that the annual privacy micro-course must be completed before attestation. The attestation form will surface the training link if your record is missing it. Please complete privacy training by Jun 14 to allow upload time.

leah-peopleops: Contractors: if your start date overlaps the window, use the contractor checkbox in the form and request an extension by Jun 12. Team leads, please verify your direct reports in the form.

notify-bot: Scheduled: "Summer attestation window opens" will also post in #general on Jun 8 at 09:00 UTC and an email reminder on Jun 18.

omar-eng: We'll collect artifacts at the squad level and nominate a lead submitter. I'll post an ENG checklist with examples (CMDB screenshot, CI job link, rotation snippet) in #eng in the morning.

sarah-security: Upload items and tag them "for review" if you want security to validate. We'll triage as accepted / needs-info / escalate and aim to close reviews by Jun 30. For audit-priority items include "audit:urgent" in the filename.

leah-peopleops: Office hours: Jun 11 16:00-17:00 UTC (drop-ins) and Jun 16 10:00-11:00 UTC (private slots via form). If you prefer a 1:1 review before submitting, book via the form.

jin-privacy: Also note: we added an "external-vendor" tag for artifacts that are third-party; include vendor contact + contract date when uploading.

leah-peopleops: TL;DR — attest + evidence due Jun 21 23:59 UTC; privacy training by Jun 14; contractor extension requests by Jun 12; office hours Jun 11 & Jun 16. Please cascade to contractors and vendors you manage. :white_check_mark:
